content: मकरः [मं विषं किरति कॄ-अच् <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A kind of sea-animal, a crocodile, shark; झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि <ls>Bg. 10. 31</ls>; मकरवक्त्र <ls>Bh. 2. 4</ls>. (Makara is regarded as an emblem of Cupid; <ab>cf.</ab> <ab>comps.</ab> below). .²2 The sign {%Capricornus%} of the zodiac. .²3 An array of troops in the form of a Makara; दण्डव्यूहेन तन्मार्गं यायात्तु शकटेन वा . वराहमकराभ्यां वा … <ls>Ms. 7. 187</ls>; <ls>Śukra. 4. 1100</ls>. .²4 An ear-ring in the shape of a Makara. .²5 The hands folded in the form of a Makara. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the nine treasures of Kubera. .²7 The tenth are of thirty degrees in any circle.
